# Sirach Chapter 32 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_032_page_001.jpg

---

**32:1** Have they made you a master of the feast? Do not be lifted up; be among them as one of themselves; take care of them and then sit down.

**32:2** And when you have fulfilled your duties, take your place, that you may be made glad on their account and receive a garland for your proper conduct.

**32:3** Speak, O elder, for it is fitting for you, but with sound judgment, and do not interrupt the music.

**32:4** Where there is entertainment, do not pour out talk; do not display wisdom at the wrong time.

**32:5** Like a ruby seal on a necklace of gold is a concert of music at a wine feast.

**32:6** Like a signet of emerald set in a gold ornament is a melody of music with pleasant and skillful wine.

**32:7** Speak, young man, only if there is need, yet no more than twice and only if asked.

**32:8** Be brief, say much in few words; be as one who knows but also knows how to hold his tongue.

**32:9** Among great men do not act as their equal, and when another is speaking do not babble.

**32:10** Lightning flashes before thunder, and before a modest man grace goes before him.

**32:11** Rise betimes and do not be last; hurry home and do not loiter.

**32:12** There amuse yourself and do what you have in your heart, but do not sin through proud speech.

**32:13** For these things, bless your Maker, who has filled you with his good things.

**32:14** Whoever fears the Lord will accept his discipline, and those who seek him early will find his favor.

**32:15** Whoever seeks the law will be filled by it, but the hypocrite will stumble over it.

**32:16** Those who fear the Lord will find true judgment, and they will kindle righteous deeds like a light.

**32:17** The sinful man shuns reproof and finds an excuse according to his own will.

**32:18** A man of judgment will not overlook a thought, and a strange and proud man will not be frightened into restraint.

**32:19** Do nothing without deliberation, and when you have acted, do not regret it.

**32:20** Do not go on a road full of obstacles, and do not stumble on a stony path.

**32:21** Do not trust in a road without obstacles, and beware of your own paths.

**32:22** In all your works guard yourself, for this is the keeping of the commandments.

**32:23** Whoever keeps the law preserves himself, and whoever trusts in the Lord will not suffer loss.

**32:24** No evil will befall the one who fears the Lord, but in trial he will be delivered again and again.
